text: National University of Computer & Emerging Sciences - NUCES - Karachi Department of Artificial Intelligence 2.3 Image Segmentation Techniques Image segmentation is a critical task in computer vision, and various techniques and methodologies are employed to achieve accurate and meaningful segmentations. Here are some common techniques and methodologies used in image segmentation: 2.3.1 Thresholding Methodology: Use Cases: Divides an image into two regions based on pixel intensity values. Pixels above a certain threshold belong to one region, and those below belong to another. Simple and effective for segmenting objects with distinct intensity differences. 2.3.1.1 Global Thresholding Methodology : Use Cases: import cv2 A single global threshold value is applied to the entire image. Effective when there is a clear intensity difference between the objects and background . image = cv2. imread(' image .jpg' , cv2. IMREAD_GRAYSCALE) = cv2.thresh01d(image, 128, 255, cv2.THRESH_BINARY) binary _ mask 2.3.1.2 Adaptive Thresholding Methodology : Use Cases: FAST NUCES Uses different threshold values for different regions of the image, which adapt to local variations in intensity. Ideal for images with varying lighting conditions. - Karachi Talha Shahid 7
